## What is the current construction schedule for the ITER fusion reactor, including key milestones and projected completion date?

Key construction milestones include site preparation beginning in 2010, the Tokamak Building basemat poured in 2013, assembly phase starting in 2020, first toroidal field coil installed in 2021, and the cryostat lower cylinder in place in 2022. [^1]

Since January 2024, the construction project’s schedule performance index has remained above 1.0, indicating progress ahead of the baseline plan. [^2]

By the end of June 2026, 192 Level 1 schedule milestones had been achieved against 188 milestones planned for the same period. [^2]
